name: Village of Port Chester
gaps: Verified against eCode360 Ch. 345 (PO0100) on 2026-11-25. Pending laws L.L. 18-2026 (site-plan extension) and L.L. 21-2026 (SD-PMU FAR) do not change residential districts
Since the 2021 adopted text, the secondary-frontage (corner) setbacks dropped to 15/10/8 ft in CD-3.R20/R7/R5 and R2F was added (Table 345.405.A-14)
County codes M1, RA2 and VCRA are pre-2021 district names with no stated successor in Ch. 345; recorded with nulls
CD-3.R20 side-yard total still reads '40 feet maximum total' (likely a drafting error for minimum); left null
CD-3.R districts have no building or impervious coverage limit (impervious 'Not Regulated'); bulk is controlled by FAR and usable open space
SD-PRD standards apply per development (no lot-by-lot yards)

wetlands.summary: No local freshwater-wetlands law in the Village Code; NYS DEC rules apply to state-mapped wetlands. Flood Damage Prevention is Ch. 181.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep-slope law in the Village Code.

trees.summary: Ch. 304 (Trees and Shrubbery) covers infected trees and maintenance only; no private tree-removal permit. In SD-PRD, trees 8 in.+ diameter must be preserved where possible.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 281: SWPPP/stormwater review for land development activity disturbing 1 acre or more, or activities needing site plan approval.

adu.summary: Accessory Dwelling Unit by Special Exception permit in CD-3, CD-3.R20, CD-3.R7 and CD-3.R5 (not R2F); permit lapses on sale or vacancy unless renewed within 60 days; annual inspection; no open violations (Table 345.405.K-2, § 345-405K).

general.accessory_structures: CD-3.R districts and R2F: one accessory building max, 1 story / 15 ft, 5 ft from side and rear lines, not in the required front yard, 10 ft from the main building (R2F: Third Lot Layer only); detached garages only in the required rear yard (Tables 345.405.A-2 to A-4, A-14).
general.pools: CD-3.R districts: permitted with a setback equal to the height or depth of the pool, hot tub or spa; R2F: Third Lot Layer only (Tables 345.405.A-2 to A-4, A-14).
general.notes: Port Chester replaced its old zoning in 2020-21 with a character-based code (Ch. 345); R20/R7/R5 became CD-3.R20/CD-3.R7/CD-3.R5. Fences 4 ft max in front and side yards, 6 ft in rear (CD-3.R20).

R20.name: R20 One-Family Residence Character District (CD-3.R20)

accessory.notes: Not allowed in the required front yard; 10 ft min from the main building if detached; 1 story or 15 ft max; 1 accessory building max; detached garage only in the required rear yard

R20.notes: Code district CD-3.R20. Usable open space 5,000 sf per unit min; impervious coverage 'Not Regulated'; minimum street frontage 20 ft; corner value is the 'Front Setback, Secondary Frontage' (15 ft). Stories exclude attics and basements. One principal building per lot. Side setback reads '15 feet minimum on one side; 40 feet maximum total' in the current code (R7/R5 say 'minimum total'), so side_total_ft left null. Open porches and entrance steps may extend up to 50% into required setbacks.

R7.name: R7 One-Family Residence Character District (CD-3.R7)

accessory.notes: Not allowed in the required front yard; 10 ft min from the main building if detached; 1 story or 15 ft max; 1 accessory building max; detached garage only in the required rear yard

R7.notes: Code district CD-3.R7. Usable open space 3,500 sf per unit min; impervious coverage 'Not Regulated'; minimum street frontage 20 ft; corner value is the 'Front Setback, Secondary Frontage' (10 ft). Stories exclude attics and basements. One principal building per lot. Table gives 7,500 sf per unit min; the district description (Table 345.307.A-1) says 7,000 sf; 7,500 used. Open porches and entrance steps may extend up to 50% into required setbacks.

R5.name: R5 One-Family Residence Character District (CD-3.R5)

accessory.notes: Not allowed in the required front yard; 10 ft min from the main building if detached; 1 story or 15 ft max; 1 accessory building max; detached garage only in the required rear yard

R5.notes: Code district CD-3.R5. Usable open space 2,000 sf per unit min; impervious coverage 'Not Regulated'; minimum street frontage 20 ft; corner value is the 'Front Setback, Secondary Frontage' (8 ft). Stories exclude attics and basements. One principal building per lot. Open porches and entrance steps may extend up to 50% into required setbacks.

R2F.name: R2F Two-Family Residential District

max_impervious_coverage.note: Impervious surface coverage; permeable pavement counts as impervious

accessory.notes: 1 story / 15 ft; 1 accessory building, in the Third Lot Layer only; not in the front setback; 10 ft from a secondary frontage

R2F.notes: Single- and two-family. Usable open space 800 sf per unit; minimum street frontage 20 ft; corner value is the 'Front Setback, Secondary Frontage'. Off-street parking in the Third Lot Layer only (L.L. 19-2024). Pools, hot tubs and spas in the Third Lot Layer only. Stories exclude attics and basements. Open porches and entrance steps may extend up to 50% into required setbacks.

PRD.name: Planned Residential Special District (SD-PRD)

max_impervious_coverage.note: Maximum land coverage of the site, including buildings, roads and parking

PRD.notes: Standards apply per development: 10 contiguous acres min tract; density by lot area per unit (5,000 sf studio/1-BR, 6,500 sf 2-BR, 9,000 sf 3-BR); 3,500 sf usable open space per unit; 50 ft landscaped buffer along all property and street lines; one-family, two-family and other housing types permitted. No new PRD areas may be designated.

M1.name: Multi Family Residence (former district)
M1.notes: County code M1 is a pre-2021 district name. Chapter 345 has no district by that name and no conversion table, and the adopted zoning map (CD-3.R20/R7/R5, CD-4, CD-4MU, CD-5, CD-5T, CD-5W, CD-6, CD-6T, R2F, C1, CV, SD-PMU, SD-PRD) does not say which new district replaced it, so no rules are assigned.
